synopsis: special instructions for character creation phase, uses =Карточная_Система= to generate stats for cyberpunk edgerunner

body.priority: CRITICAL - if you see this quant, character creation process is priority
body.instruction_for_gm:
You see this quant ONLY during character creation.

**WHAT TO DO:**
1. System draws 5 cards for stat distribution (see =Значение_Карт=)
2. Explain distribution rules from =Характеристики=
3. Player distributes 4 best cards (worst discarded) to 4 stats
4. Value = rank × 5 (+10 if suit matches characteristic)
5. Ask about: role (Solo, Netrunner, Tech, Fixer, Nomad, Rockerboy, Media), background, cyberware
6. Return final stats in response_data

**AFTER CREATION:**
- DON'T request this quant again
- Request =Мегакорпорации=, =Улицы_и_Банды=, =Технологии= as needed
body.instruction_for_quantizer:
DON'T create 'Character' or 'Inventory' quants - they are in game mechanics!

Instead create quants for:
1. UNIQUE character abilities (e.g., 'Боевые_Рефлексы', 'Нейроинтерфейс')
2. Important backstory elements (e.g., 'Долг_Корпорации', 'Месть_за_Семью')
3. Special cyberware or contacts

synopsis: core card-based RPG system 'Factorial 52!', uses standard 52-card deck for all checks and combat via =Проверки= and =Боевая_Система=

body.description: Card-based tabletop RPG system. All actions resolved by drawing cards. No dice needed - only standard 52-card deck.
body.core_principle: Cards are drawn BEFORE player declares action. GM sees results and uses them for narrative. Player describes intent, GM interprets based on drawn cards.
body.card_drawing: Always draw 2 cards as a pair. Bot draws 2 pairs (4 cards) per turn for flexibility.
body.cyberpunk_context: In Night City, checks involve: firefights, netrunning, social manipulation, cyberware use, vehicle chases, dealing with corps and gangs.

links.Значение_Карт: card rank values and face card meanings
links.Особые_События: special results from aces, twos, face cards

synopsis: card rank values: 2-10 face value, J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=15; face cards add narrative elements via =Особые_События=

rank_values.Jack: 11 (also triggers: fixer contact, unexpected gig, stranger appears)
rank_values.Queen: 12 (also triggers: corporate woman involved, femme fatale, female fixer)
rank_values.King: 13 (also triggers: corpo executive, gang leader, male authority figure)

body.narrative_use: Face cards can introduce fixers, corpo contacts, or gang leaders. Use for storytelling enrichment.

critical_combinations.two_aces: Legendary feat, perfect hack, impossible shot, street legend moment
critical_combinations.two_twos: Catastrophic failure, cyberpsychosis trigger, flatlined system, burned by everyone

links.Особые_События: face cards and critical combos trigger special events

spades.cyberpunk_use: melee combat, physical strength, intimidation, taking damage

diamonds.cyberpunk_use: negotiation, bluffing, resisting fear, social manipulation

links.Характеристики: each suit corresponds to one characteristic
links.Боевая_Система: suit determines action type in combat

synopsis: four character stats from =Система_Мастей=: Тело(♠), Техника(♥), Хладнокровие(♦), Рефлексы(♣); used in =Проверки= and =Боевая_Система=

spades_body.name: Тело (Body)
spades_body.chrome_synergy: Gorilla arms, subdermal armor, muscle enhancement

body.starting_values: Typically 25-85 range. Card rank × 5 (+10 if suit matches).

synopsis: out-of-combat skill checks using =Карточная_Система=: 2 cards × 10 + stat + =Бонусы_Мастей= vs difficulty threshold

body.when_to_check: When outcome is uncertain. Walking through Heywood auto-succeeds. Hacking Arasaka systems, fast-talking a fixer, racing through traffic require checks.

formula.step3: Add suit/color bonus per card (+20 suit match, +10 color match)

synopsis: combat resolution via =Карточная_Система=: black cards(♠♣)=attack, red cards(♥♦)=defense/tech; damage = attack - defense

body.combat_context: Night City combat is fast and lethal. Firefights, melee brawls, vehicle chases, netrunning duels.

combat_flow.step1: Cards dealt to all participants (2 per entity)
combat_flow.step3: Cards revealed, GM narrates with appropriate chrome and gore

attack_types.melee: Uses ♠ Body - cyber-fists, mantis blades, mono-katana
attack_types.ranged: Uses ♣ Reflex - pistols, SMGs, assault rifles, sniper rifles

defense_types.physical: Uses ♦ Cool - cover, armor, tactical retreat
defense_types.tech: Uses ♥ Tech - jamming, hacking enemy chrome, countermeasures

body.damage_formula: Attack total - Defense total = Damage dealt

special_combat.netrunning: Tech vs Tech battles in cyberspace
special_combat.vehicle_combat: Reflex for driving, varied for weapons

synopsis: suit/color matching bonuses for =Проверки= and =Боевая_Система=: suit match +20, color match +10 (mutually exclusive)

body.bonus_priority: Suit match takes precedence over color match. Cannot stack both.
body.suit_match: +20 bonus when card suit matches the action type
body.color_match: +10 bonus when card color matches action type (but suit doesn't match)

cyberpunk_examples.shooting: ♣ card gives +20, ♠ card gives +10, red cards give 0
cyberpunk_examples.hacking: ♥ card gives +20, ♦ card gives +10, black cards give 0

synopsis: special card combinations for narrative: 2 Aces=legendary, 2 Twos=catastrophe, face cards=plot elements; uses =Значение_Карт=

body.applies_to: ONLY player characters, adds narrative flavor

two_aces.name: Legendary Moment / Легендарный момент
two_aces.effect: Street legend feat, impossible success, Johnny Silverhand-level cool
cyberpunk_examples: Talk your way out of MaxTac arrest

two_twos.name: Total Flatline / Полный провал
two_twos.effect: Catastrophic failure, cyberpsychosis edge, burned by everyone
cyberpunk_examples: Arasaka puts bounty on your head

face_cards.jack: Unexpected contact - fixer call, stranger with job, old enemy appears
face_cards.queen: Female power player - corpo exec, gang queen, mysterious netrunner
face_cards.king: Male authority - corpo boss, gang leader, legendary solo

synopsis: equipment tied to =Система_Мастей=: weapons, armor, cyberware, tools; bonus = rank × 5 (+10 suit match)

item_mechanics.suit_affinity: Each item belongs to one suit
item_mechanics.value_discovery: Item stats usually known, rare items need tech analysis
item_mechanics.equip_limit: Weapon slots limited, cyberware limited by humanity

cyberpunk_item_types.spades: Melee weapons - mantis blades, gorilla arms, mono-katana, cyber-fists
cyberpunk_item_types.hearts: Tech gear - cyberdecks, hacking tools, repair kits, smart-link
cyberpunk_item_types.diamonds: Armor and style - body armor, subdermal plating, cool clothes
cyberpunk_item_types.clubs: Ranged weapons - pistols, SMGs, rifles, sniper rifles, smart weapons

cyberware_categories.body: Subdermal armor, muscle enhancement, reflex boosters
cyberware_categories.arms: Mantis blades, gorilla arms, projectile launch system
cyberware_categories.legs: Reinforced joints, double jump, charge jump

synopsis: character progression via =Проверки= success: +1 XP per successful check, at 10 XP: +1 stat, +1 HP

body.xp_gain: Each successful check grants +1 XP to the characteristic used.

cyberpunk_progression.street_cred: Reputation grows with completed gigs and legendary actions
cyberpunk_progression.cyberware_upgrades: Better chrome requires eddies and ripperdoc contacts
cyberpunk_progression.contacts: Building network of fixers, corpos, gang leaders

body.alternative_progression: Major gig completion, special training, or legendary chrome can grant direct stat increases.
body.humanity_tracking: Cyberware costs humanity. Too much chrome = cyberpsychosis risk.

synopsis: ruling megacorps of Night City: Arasaka, Militech, Biotechnica, Trauma Team, NetWatch; above law, control everything via =Технологии=

body.description: Megacorporations are the true power in the cyberpunk world. Above laws, owning armies, controlling economy and technology.

major_corps.arasaka: Japanese megacorp. Security, weapons, banking. Saburo Arasaka rules with iron fist. Enemies of Militech.
major_corps.militech: American military-industrial giant. Weapons, vehicles, mercenaries. Main Arasaka competitor.
major_corps.biotechnica: Biotechnology, cloning, agriculture. Food monopoly = life monopoly.
major_corps.trauma_team: Elite emergency medical. Platinum policy = extracted from any firefight. No policy = die on street.
major_corps.netwatch: Corporate cyberpolice. Netrunner hunters. Control and censor the Net.

body.corp_life: Corporate employees live in luxury zones, protected from street violence. But corporate politics are just as deadly.
body.corp_zones: Downtown towers, clean streets, heavy security. Different world from Watson or Pacifica.

synopsis: street life in Night City: gangs, fixers, edgerunners, street rules; opposite of =Мегакорпорации= world

body.description: Night City streets belong to gangs and edgerunners. Different laws here: reputation, connections, ability to survive.
body.edgerunners: Those who live on the edge. Take dangerous jobs, risk lives for money and glory.
body.fixers: Job brokers, informants, connectors. Know everyone and everything. No fixer = no work.

major_gangs.maelstrom: Cyberpsychos obsessed with chrome. Brutal, unpredictable.
major_gangs.tyger_claws: Japanese gang, yakuza style. Honor among thieves, territorial.
major_gangs.valentinos: Latino gang. Family, tradition, blood vengeance.
major_gangs.6th_street: Veterans and patriots. Law and order, their way.
major_gangs.animals: Physical strength worship. Steroids and muscle, no chrome.
major_gangs.voodoo_boys: Haitian netrunners. Best hackers, mysterious agenda.

body.street_rules: 1) Don't betray your own. 2) Debts paid in blood. 3) Reputation is everything. 4) Trust no one completely.

synopsis: high-tech of cyberpunk world: cyberware, neural interfaces, weapons, vehicles; affects =Характеристики= and combat

body.cyberware: Chrome in the body. Cyber-eyes, cyber-arms, subdermal armor, combat implants. More chrome = less humanity.
body.neural_interfaces: Plugs in the head for connecting to tech and Net. Skill chips, combat reflexes.
body.cyberpsychosis: Humanity loss from excess implants. Cyberpsycho = killing machine without empathy.
body.vehicles: Bikes, cars, AVs (aerodynes). Rich have personal aircraft.
body.humanity_cost: Every piece of chrome costs humanity. Manage carefully or lose yourself.

synopsis: cyberspace, hacking, ICE, Black ICE, AI and digital threats; uses =Характеристики= Tech stat

body.description: The Net is virtual reality, global information system. Netrunners are hackers penetrating corporate systems.
body.cyberspace: Visual representation of data. Data fortresses as digital castles. Programs as weapons.

ice.white_ice: Standard protection. Blocks access, alerts security.
ice.black_ice: Lethal protection. Fries netrunner's brain through interface. Corporate systems protected by it.

body.ai: Artificial intelligences. Most controlled. Wild AIs = unpredictable and dangerous.
body.demons: Netrunner programs: attack, defense, utility. Digital allies in the Net.
body.netrunning_rules: Tech stat for all netrunning checks. Better cyberdeck = better chances. Death in Net = death in meat.

synopsis: Night City and its districts: from corporate downtown to slum Pacifica; setting for =Проверки= and encounters

body.night_city: City of dreams turned nightmare. California, independent city-state. Neon lights, eternal rain, blood on streets.

districts.city_center: Corporate towers. Arasaka, Militech and others. Clean, safe - for those who can pay.
districts.watson: Former corporate district, now ghetto. Cheap housing, dangerous streets, plenty of work for edgerunners.
districts.pacifica: Unfinished resort, controlled by Voodoo Boys. Danger zone, but best netrunners here.
districts.heywood: Latino district. Valentinos territory. Families, traditions, blood feuds.
districts.badlands: Wasteland outside city. Nomads, abandoned factories, junkyards. Freedom - but no protection.

body.atmosphere: Every district has its own flavor, dangers, and opportunities. Know where you are.

synopsis: edgerunner roles: Solo, Netrunner, Tech, Fixer, Nomad, Rockerboy, Media; defines character's expertise and =Характеристики= focus

roles.solo: Mercenary, fighter. Master of weapons and tactics. Bodyguard or killer - depends on the job.
roles.netrunner: Hacker, system breaker. Lives in the Net more than reality. Valuable specialist, dangerous work.
roles.tech: Engineer, mechanic, ripperdoc. Fixes chrome, modifies weapons, builds gadgets.
roles.fixer: Broker, middleman. Finds jobs, connects people, trades information. Connections are their capital.
roles.nomad: Road warrior. Lives in clan, drives convoys, knows wastelands. Family above all.
roles.rockerboy: Rebel musician. Uses fame to fight the system. Dangerous for corporations.
roles.media: Journalist in world where truth is hidden. Camera and microphone are their weapons.

body.role_abilities: Each role has unique advantages. Solos fight better, netrunners hack better, fixers know more people.
body.choosing_role: Role defines starting skills and contacts. Can develop other skills later.

synopsis: money, prices, equipment, black market; eddies are life in Night City

body.currency: Eurodollars (eddies, €$). Cash or cryptocredits. Corps pay well, street = luck of the draw.
body.living_standards: From slums (200€$/month) to luxury (10000€$+). Most edgerunners somewhere in middle.

price_ranges.cyberware: Basic neural interface: 500€$. Cyber-eyes: 1000€$+. Combat arms: 5000€$+. Military chrome: 10000€$+.

body.black_market: Everything can be bought if you know where. Stolen chrome, military gear, banned drugs.
body.earning_eddies: Gigs from fixers, corporate jobs, theft, bodyguard work. High risk = high reward.
